title: change meta.yml
description: Contract for every specs/changes/<folder>/meta.yml. A change is a first-class, TRACKED unit of work (unlike optis' disposable work order) — SAFE only because it is folded into features/ on `archive`. STRUCTURAL only; enum values validated by `specs.mjs check` against spec.config.json.

task_code.description: Ticket / task identifier, e.g. OPCS-142. The lookup key (folder name has no timestamp).

type.description: One of spec.config.json.change_types (default Add|Modify|Remove|Fix). 'Add' CREATES the target feature on fold; the others PATCH it.

acceptance_stage.description: Test-suite maturity of THIS change's acceptance, one of spec.config.json.acceptance_stages.

depends_on.description: The target feature ID(s) this change folds into. For type Add the ID(s) are CREATED on fold; for Modify/Remove/Fix they must already exist. Each must appear as a '## <FEATURE-ID>' block in this change's spec.md.
